描述_EN: a yi would have been used with a basin, in a cleansing ceremony. each vessel had a specific name according to its shape and function. in ancient china metalworkers made a great variety of bronze vessels for ritual use. this bronze pouring vessel is called a 'yi' in chinese.
描述_ZN: "伊 "是与盆子一起使用的，用于清洁仪式。 每个容器根据其形状和功能都有一个特定的名字。 在古代中国，金属工人制造了大量的用于仪式的青铜器。 这个青铜浇注器在中国被称为 "伊"。
